Equipped with a key lock slot and keys to ensure security

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The ZH-405N Cash Drawer is a durable and secure solution designed for point-of-sale (POS) systems, offering organized storage for cash transactions. Here are its detailed features and specifications:​

Key Features:

  • Compartments: 5 adjustable note compartments and 5 coin compartments for efficient cash organization.
  • Cheque Slot: Includes a dedicated slot for cheques or large bills.
  • Lock Mechanism: Equipped with a key lock slot and keys to ensure security.
  • Interface: RJ11 connector for seamless integration with POS systems.
  • Construction: Made from high-quality materials ensuring durability and longevity.
  • Color: Black.

Specifications:

  • Dimensions: 405 mm (Width) × 410 mm (Depth) × 110 mm (Height).
  • Weight: Approximately 5.5 kg.
  • Current: ≤1.85A.
  • Opening Methods: Can be opened electrically via POS command or manually using a key.

This cash drawer is ideal for retail environments, supermarkets, and any business requiring a reliable and secure cash handling solution.
